title.romaji: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run
title.english: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run
title.native: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 Part7 スティール・ボール・ラン

description: In 1890, the world's greatest cross-country horse race begins: the Steel Ball Run. Spanning 6,000 kilometers from San Diego Beach to New York City with a 50 million dollar grand prize, competitors from across the globe gather. Former horse racing prodigy Johnny Joestar, paralyzed from the waist down, witnesses the mysterious Spin technique of the enigmatic Gyro Zeppeli and sets out to race across America to discover the secrets of the Spin and the Holy Corpse.
